Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the image rendered as a pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Compare the source scene with the edited image across the whole frame. A pencil-drawing rendering requires recognizable graphite-like contours and pencil-like tonal strokes or shading to replace photographic rendering across the scene. Look for visible drawn marks that define forms and tones, rather than merely reduced color, grain, blur, or softened photographic edges. Judge the extent of this treatment across the food, dishes, pitcher, glass, tablecloth, and surrounding background. The endpoint remains incomplete when substantial regions or major objects retain photographic forms, shading, or texture; full achievement requires the pencil-drawn treatment throughout the image, allowing natural variation in texture and lighting.
node.binding: Compare SOURCE with EDITED: assess whether the requested transformation renders the source image as a pencil drawing across the whole image. Judge visible graphite-like contours and pencil-like tonal strokes or shading on the food, dishes, and surrounding background; do not count desaturation, grain, blur, or softened photographic edges alone as pencil-drawing fulfillment.
node.source_quote: Change the image into pencil drawing
node.endpoint: The image is rendered as a pencil drawing.
node.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
node.zero_when: No requested pencil-drawing change is visible; unrelated edits do not count.
node.half_when: About half of the image’s visual content has visible pencil-specific treatment, such as graphite-like contours or pencil-like tonal strokes replacing photographic rendering, while substantial content remains in its original non-pencil rendering. Desaturation, grain, blur, or softened edges alone do not count as that treatment.
node.full_when: The image’s visual content is rendered throughout in a recognizable pencil-drawing style, with graphite-like contours and pencil-like tonal strokes or shading replacing photographic rendering across the scene, allowing natural variation in texture and lighting. Muted color, grain, blur, or softened edges alone do not establish full achievement.

node_traces.evidence: The edit is muted and grainy, but most of the scene still looks photographic or merely softened. There are some sketch-like tonal marks and contours on the food and dishes, yet they do not consistently replace photographic shading across the scene; the pitcher, glass, tablecloth, and background lack clear pencil strokes. Thus only a limited portion of the requested pencil-drawing treatment is achieved.
